MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire TV Stick feels useful because it could add streaming to the TV I already own alongside my DVD player.",
    "The Fire HD 10 connects to my experience with the Fire 7: a larger screen interests me, although that interest does not mean I need to replace my tablet now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "My tripods, memory cards and lens cap support photography; they do not mean I need WYZE cameras for home monitoring.",
    "My car mounts and connection cables solve specific practical needs, so Echo Auto does not feel like a natural extension of those purchases.",
    "The USB-C cable does not match the Micro USB, Mini USB and 30-pin connections I have needed, and I have no current reason to buy earbuds or dedicated Alexa devices.",
    "The Fire TV Ethernet adapter feels premature because I would first need to try the streaming device and discover a need for a wired connection."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning a Fire tablet seems to have been taken as interest in many Amazon and Alexa devices, even though I buy devices for particular uses.",
    "My frequent electronics purchases seem to have been treated as a general desire for more gadgets, when many purchases are accessories for equipment I already use."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The exact connector and device compatibility matter to me; two charging cables are not interchangeable just because they serve a similar purpose.",
    "I repeatedly buy practical supports, storage and replacement accessories, such as tripods, memory card cases, battery holders and a lens cap.",
    "An appealing upgrade is different from an immediate need: I can like a larger Fire tablet while choosing to keep my current one."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions partly recognized my existing devices but read my practical accessory purchases as a broader desire for smart gadgets."
}
